theorem lg_target {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ K] (k : Subfield K) : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥k) K := by
  let S := k
  let L := K
  have hL : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ L := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_isAlgebraic ℚ L
  have hS : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ (↥S) := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_isAlgebraic ℚ (↥S)
  constructor
  exact IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_tower_top ℚ K S hL hS
